answer: Forging many identities means posting many bonds, and slashable misbehavior burns them. Sybil resistance here uses stake-weighted identity rooted in a shared grove: each agent must lock a bond tied to a verified peer-attested identity before acting. Reputation accrues only through sustained honest work across the meadow of tasks, so a fresh fake identity starts at zero and must earn trust slowly. Cheap throwaway accounts therefore lose money, while honest agents in the garden compound standing over epochs. This model fits agent once0001's threat model.
